 Follow VisionQuest Gets New Spin-off Project With Paul Bettany, Iman Vellani, & More MCU Stars
 Anuraag Chatterjee Wed, November 4, 2026 at 10:45 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Photo Credit - Disney+ Marvel Studios has revealed that VisionQuest will receive a spin-off project set to air on November 10, 2026. Hosted by Ms. Marvel star Iman Vellani and The Basement Yard's Frank Alvarez, it will feature Paul Bettany, James Spader, Ruaridh Mollica, and showrunner Terry Matalas.
 The VisionQuest Official Podcast is set to debut concurrently on Disney+ as the show streams its finale at 6 p.m. ET. The involvement of key cast members allows fans to discover what went into making the project that served as the trilogy's finale, beginning with WandaVision. The podcast will likely focus on lesser-known aspects of the MCU and Marvel comics.
 Paul Bettany, James Spader & more Marvel stars are coming together for VisionQuest podcast
 The VisionQuest podcast will feature some of the biggest names from the project and the franchise. James Spader first essayed the role of Ultron in Avengers: Age of Ultron and reprises the role in VisionQuest. Paul Bettany joined the franchise with the same film, and subsequently appeared in Captain America: Civil War, Avengers: Infinity War, and WandaVision.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The show's finale will likely clarify the situation with Vision and Wanda's family. It's the last Marvel project featuring a mainline Avenger before the MCU moves toward Avengers: Doomsday. However, the finale probably would not provide insights into upcoming theatrical releases; the podcast after the episode might offer more information.
 Although it's not a traditional media interview and comes directly from Marvel, the questions and answers in the episode are likely carefully crafted to avoid revealing any information about Doomsday. However, with the recent increase in marketing for Doomsday, the podcast might share new hints about Doctor Doom's plans for the multiverse. Avengers: Doomsday is set for theatrical release on December 18, 2026.
 The VisionQuest Official Podcast will be available on Disney+, Marvel's YouTube channel, and major podcast platforms.
